title: perf(sharing): ask record sharing for the write verdicts of a predicate write's candidates as one set
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8ZBQe4UHadd2fGHGeWRW9V)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Fixes #35934
Ruling-ref: 7190344023
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到什么变化：成员或「修改全部」管理员按条件批量改、删上万条记录时，速度从几秒降到零点几秒；改哪些行、删哪些行与之前完全一样。
- 为什么做：属于「记录共享与权限性能」这一组工作，解决批量写入时权限检查逐行读库、读数随行数增长的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是批量写入里本该放行的行被拒（查询失败一律按拒绝处理，不会多放行）；新能力是可选的，撤回本次改动即恢复逐行检查。
- 要你做什么：新增的两个接口名称在你的否决窗口内，请确认或否决命名。

## What changes

`ISharingService` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`) gains two OPTIONAL members, as ruled (option C):

- `checkEditMany(object, recordIds, context)` and `checkDeleteMany(object, recordIds, context)`.
- Each answers `SharingWriteVerdict[]`: answer i is the verdict `checkEdit` / `checkDelete` answers for `recordIds[i]` (same length, same order, repeats kept).
- Same bases, same order of decision, same verb boundary: an `edit` share is `allow` to `checkEditMany` and `deny` to `checkDeleteMany`.
- A chunk whose lookup fails answers `deny` for each of its records, never `abstain`.
- Name and precedent: `checkEdit` / `checkDelete` on this same contract, plus the data protocol's `…Many` suffix (`IDataDriver.updateMany?` / `deleteMany?`, both optional). Two members rather than one with a verb argument, because this contract already splits the write verdict by verb.

`SharingService` (`plugin-sharing`) implements both. `checkEdit` / `checkDelete` are now the one-record case of the same private `writeVerdicts`:

- Object-level decisions (bypass list, schema, OWD, owner field, principal) are made once per call.
- Ids are read in chunks of 1,000 (`WRITE_VERDICT_CHUNK`; the docblock gives the dialect bounds: Oracle's 1,000-item IN list, SQL Server's 2,100 parameters).
- Per chunk: one read of the rows (owner, and queue plus organization when the object has an ownership queue column), and for an update one read of the caller's write-level shares.
- The owner set, each queue membership and the Modify All probe are resolved at most once per call.
- A single record costs the reads it always did. One exception: an update on an object with an ownership queue column now reads the row once instead of twice (queue and owner in one read).

`SecurityPlugin` (`plugin-security`) feature-detects the set form on the kernel's `sharing` service on the predicate write floor relief (#35802 / #35914):

- If the set form is there: one set-form call for the candidates the platform floor does not admit, with one context built once (`__writeScope`, the external grant patch). An answer that is not `allow` or `deny` normalises to `abstain`. A probe that throws, or a list of the wrong length, gives `deny` for all, with one error logged.
- If it is not there: per row, 25 at a time, exactly as before.
- Delegated callers are still not asked.
- Which rows are written is unchanged either way.

Not in this PR (as ordered): the 2a authored-scope change. Untouched: ADR-0155, `buildWriteFilter` and every find.

Changeset: patch for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` and `@objectstack/plugin-security`. Rule read: AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3. Kind `none` gives patch, and an optional, non-protocol contract widening ships patch.

## Tests

Measured on SQLite, N = 10,000 rows owned by another user. The bench is the kept one from report 7187608580, extended with set-form counting and a per-row mode. It is uncommitted, as ordered. Set form is this branch; per-row is the same branch without the set members; main is the report's readings.

| case | main | per-row on this branch | set form |
|---|---|---|---|
| member predicate update | 20,004 reads · 6,013 ms | 20,004 · 6,603 ms | **24 reads · 270 ms** |
| member predicate delete | 10,003 reads · 2,178 ms | 10,003 · 1,957 ms | **13 reads · 111 ms** |
| Modify All predicate update (10,000 written) | 10,004 reads · 1,880 ms | 10,004 · 1,765 ms | **14 reads · 242 ms** |

- Set mode made one set call per write, with at most one bypass probe (per row: 10,000).
- The per-row reads equal main's, so the by-id path gained no read.

New pins:

- `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.test.ts`, **equivalence**: `checkEditMany` / `checkDeleteMany` equal `checkEdit` / `checkDelete` on every row.
  - Objects × callers × verbs: private with a queue column, public read/write, no owner field, phantom owner anchor, shares inert, unknown object.
  - Callers: member, unit depth, Modify All at own and org depth, delegated, principal-less, guest, system.
  - Rows: own, owner-not-creator, created-not-owned, edit-shared, read-shared, queue mine / not mine / other org, ownerless, missing.
  - Also: the empty list, and order with repeats.
- Same file, **counted reads**: 10,000 records give 10 row reads, 10 share reads, 1 bypass probe and 1 owner set; a delete makes 0 share reads. A per-row control of 300 rows gives 300 / 200 / 100. A queue membership is asked once over 2,500 rows.
- Same file, **fail-closed**: 1,500 ids with a failing second chunk give 500 `deny` and one log line. A share read that throws denies its whole chunk, owned rows included.
- `plugin-security/src/predicate-write-floor-deferral.test.ts`, **feature-detect**:
  - The #35914 rig's 60 candidates go in one set call.
  - Without the set form: the same rows and the same per-row asked list for ALICE, BOB, CAROL, the manager, DAVE and two delegated callers, for update and delete.
  - Host doubles: stringified ids, normalisation, a throwing or wrong-length answer gives all `deny`, and delegated or no-floor callers are not asked.

Ablations: each one was committed first, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, and restored (blob equals HEAD, `git status` clean).

1. Share membership emptied: 7 equivalence cases red.
2. The chunk catch answers `abstain`: 2 fail-closed cases red.
3. `WRITE_VERDICT_CHUNK = 1`: 2 counted-reads cases red.
4. Feature-detect `return null` changed to `return []`: 10 plugin-security cases red.

## Acceptance notes

- Docs: `content/docs/**/sharing-service.mdx` lists only the boolean methods, and says nothing about bulk write cost. It is outside this card's file surface, so it is left to the docs-drift follow-up.
- The pending changeset from #35802 describes the per-row cost that this PR supersedes in the same release; this changeset states the new cost.
- By id, an update of a queue-column object now reads queue and owner in one row read instead of two. The verdicts are pinned equal.
- The bench file is not committed (dispatch order).

## Verification

- Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sharing-service.test.ts -t "35934"`. Expect every `[#35934]` case green, including `10,000 records: two reads per chunk of 1,000`.
- Read first, by risk:
  1. `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`, `writeVerdicts`: the per-row order inside the chunk loop, and the try per chunk.
  2. `plugin-security/src/security-plugin-sharing-verdicts.ts`, `resolveSharingWriteVerdicts`: normalisation and the length check.
  3. `packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`: the member docblocks.

Local runs at the final head `14bf9f91`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `plugin-sharing`: `pnpm test` gives 78 files, 1,748 passed / 11 skipped. Typecheck passed. `sharing-service.test.ts` was re-run after the last commit: 289 passed.
- `plugin-security`: `pnpm test` gives 290 files, 7,330 passed / 45 skipped. Typecheck passed. Run at `c6f613be`; the last commit touched only a `plugin-sharing` test file.
- `spec`: `src/contracts/sharing-service.test.ts` gives 15 passed, and `check:generated` reports all 14 artefacts up to date.
- Dogfood: the dependency closure was built, then the nine files that judge the sharing write paths were run. 9 files, 110 tests passed. The files: authored-row-write-scope, bulk-widener-probe, owd-public-read-write-write-floor, showcase-scope-depth-write, federated-phantom-share-grant, direct-share-grant-is-manual, cbp-parent-attachment-comment-gates, predicate-write-unreadable-not-matched, armed.

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 95 derived, 95 run</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` gives 95 commands. The list is the same at `c6f613be` and at `14bf9f91`. The `--ran` reconciliation reports 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The full run was at `c6f613be`: 92 exited 0 and 3 exited 1.
  - `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` went red while a concurrent closure build of mine had `packages/plugins/organizations/dist` half-written. Re-run after the build: both exit 0 (267/267 declaration files; 127 require entry points load).
  - `check:where-matcher` was a real finding: the new engine double read a where combinator as a field name. Fixed in `14bf9f91` (the double now refuses a combinator), and the gate exits 0.
- 20 families that read test files were re-run at `14bf9f91`, and all 20 exited 0: where-matcher, objectql-double-limit, engine-double-contract, nul-bytes, test-source-alias, type-check-debt, cross-package-test-inputs, query-options-erasure, refd-timer-probe and eleven more.
- Local-only `check:dev-prereqs` scan: NOT MEASURED (`--self-test` passed). This box has 35 unrelated `@object-ui` packages unbuilt, and the scan judges the whole workspace.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` at `14bf9f91` gives VERDICT clean: it merges cleanly with origin/main `1af67b26`, and no open pull request head shares a file.

</details>
